title: Lyme Disease | CDC
content: Lyme Disease About Lyme disease information on symptoms, prevention, tick removal, testing, and what CDC is doing. Learn More Aug 26, 2024 Signs and Symptoms Lyme disease can cause fever, rash, and arthritis. Seek prompt medical care if symptoms appear. How It Spreads Blacklegged ticks spread Lyme disease in the U.S. Remove ticks within 24 hours to prevent infection. Surveillance and Data Lyme disease is a nationally notifiable condition. Health departments report cases to CDC. For professionals Clinical Care and Treatment Early diagnosis and antibiotic treatment of Lyme disease can prevent more serious health issues. May 15, 2024 Clinical Testing and Diagnosis CDC recommends a two-step serologic testing process for Lyme disease using FDA-cleared assays. May 15, 2024 Neurologic Lyme Disease Early disseminated Lyme disease can cause neurological problems. Treat with oral or IV antibiotics. Lyme Carditis Lyme carditis disrupts heart signals, causing heart block. Treat with oral or IV antibiotics. Lyme Arthritis Treat early Lyme arthritis with 4 weeks of antibiotics. Persistent cases may need a rheumatologist. Erythema Migrans Rash Adjust Lyme disease treatment regimens for erythema migrans rash based on patient-specific factors. Clinical Resources Treat and prevent Lyme disease through current guidance, tools, and references for health providers.
